# I’m running

## The governing thesis
We all want more housing, lively streets, and transit that runs on time. The progressive model and the moderate model get treated like rival teams when they should be sharing a playbook.
San Francisco doesn’t have a values problem. We have a coordination problem, and coordination problems have solutions.
The Platform
## Five promises for District 8.
### Get the basics right
Childcare waitlists and 311 cases that feel open forever. The city leaves work unfinished. I won’t.
Read more →
### Actually build housing
The city approves homes it never builds. I’ll fix the steps between “yes” and a foundation in the ground.
Read more →
### Make every block feel safer
Feeling safe and being safe aren’t the same thing. D8’s safety spending treats them like they are. I won’t.
Read more →
### Keep the lights on
A new business shouldn’t have to survive City Hall before it survives the market. I’ll fix the process.
Read more →
### Read the full platform
Every proposal. Every number. Every honest limitation.
Read more →
New to Darshini?
## The short version.
First-generation American. Born and raised in the Bay Area. Apparently incapable of sitting anything out. I’ve worked in the White House, on two presidential campaigns, and at a company that scaled from 15 to over 7,000 cities. Noe Valley is home. I’d like it to work better.
Three things I’ll do first: launch a publicly available housing tracker so nothing stalls in the dark, update the permitting rules that block new childcare slots, and collect the vacancy tax that 40% of property owners have never filed.

Dennise Gearty
Vice President, Diamond Heights Community Association
Ranked 1st
“
San Francisco politics often gets bogged down in endless debate and idealistic fluff, but Darshini Patel brings a refreshing, reality-based focus to the Board of Supervisors. What stands out most about Darshini is her competence and commitment to execution.
District 8 needs a leader who is honest about what local government can control, focused on fixing broken administrative processes, and dedicated to pragmatic solutions over rhetoric. Darshini is that leader, and she has my full support.
From neighbors and colleagues
“
I worked with Darshini at DoorDash, and what I saw there is exactly what District 8 needs right now.
Darshini didn’t just ship projects — she drove outcomes. I watched her take on some of the hardest, most ambiguous challenges at the company and turn them into work that moved the business forward in ways people could actually measure. She built the function that advocated for restaurant operators from the ground up, and she did it by listening first and building second. When COVID hit, her team didn’t wait for a playbook — they stood up emergency support in weeks.
But what I want people to know about Darshini goes beyond her professional track record. The way she moves through the world is rare. She is constantly thinking about the people around her — what they need, what’s getting in their way, how to clear the path. I’ve never seen her put herself first. She leads with respect for everyone in the room, whether it’s a CEO or someone brand new on the team. That’s not something you can fake, and it’s not something you can teach. It’s just who she is.
District 8 deserves a supervisor who knows how to deliver and who genuinely cares about every person she serves. Darshini is that person.
Read more ↓
“
Darshini immediately impressed me with her deep understanding of District 8 and the gap between what politicians promise and what gets delivered. Whether it’s childcare, transit, housing, or permits for small businesses, Darshini discovered root causes for many of the economic challenges in the neighborhood came from long wait times associated with government administrative services.
These wait times, in many cases, are outrageous and infuriating and it’s clear that Darshini not only understands what causes them, but how to fix them. I firmly believe that resolution speed is something that elected officials need to pay better attention to, and Darshini’s focus on delivery speed really sets her apart from other candidates.
“
Darshini’s platform is exactly what I’d expect from 10 years of knowing her — professionally and personally. Professionally, it shows her ability to find opportunity in chaos, simplicity in complexity, and solutions where others see only problems. Personally, it shows the deep empathy she has for the people around her, her keen ability to understand what they actually need, and her unwavering desire to help. District 8 will be better with Darshini in office.
“
Darshini has the most nuanced, thoughtful platform and consistently outperforms all of the other candidates at forums. I support her grassroots efforts and hope she brings change to the district!
“
I’ve spent enough time with Darshini to know that not only does she get things done, but she does them well and always ensures that they’re done in a thoughtful and inclusive way. I would be so relieved to know that she is representing Cole Valley and all of D8 as Supervisor making our city safer, easier to live, and a great place to be a parent.
“
As an acupuncturist in our community, I have the privilege of working closely with individuals and families from all walks of life. It is with great confidence and enthusiasm that I endorse Darshini for District 8.
I have known her for the past four years and have come to deeply respect her as a thoughtful, intelligent, and deeply committed member of our neighborhood. She is not only highly educated and well-informed, but also genuinely curious and driven to understand the real issues affecting our community. I often see her engaging with local business owners and residents, taking the time to listen and learn. That kind of presence matters.
Coming from an immigrant family, she understands both the challenges and the opportunities that shape so many of our lives. Her background has given her resilience, perspective, and a strong work ethic. She approaches problems with critical thinking and compassion, always looking for practical solutions that serve everyone.
What stands out most to me is her integrity and authenticity. She is personable, approachable, and truly cares. She represents a new generation of leadership — one that is inclusive, thoughtful, and forward-looking.
I wholeheartedly support Darshini and believe she will serve our district with intelligence, dedication, and heart.
Read more ↓
“
Darshini was one of the most instrumental individuals to hold together our statewide Get-Out-The-Vote program during the 2024 election. She is deeply logistically minded and is a great choice to lead during this tumultuous period. I am better for having worked with her, and I know she will make SF better.
“
San Francisco has spent too long trapped in tired arguments while the same failures keep repeating in public. Housing gets debated, approved, delayed, and diluted. Transit absorbs endless discussion without becoming reliably better. Residents and small businesses get worn down by systems that are slow, fragmented, and too often unaccountable. The city does not suffer from a lack of stated values. It suffers from a failure to convert intent into execution.
What I find compelling about Darshini is that she seems focused on that exact layer of civic life where trust is either built or destroyed. Coordination. Follow-through. Accountability. The hard work that begins after the speech, after the endorsement, after the vote, when somebody has to stay with the problem long enough to make government actually function.
That matters to me. Competence in public office shapes the texture of daily life. It determines whether a city becomes more livable, more predictable, and more possible for the people trying to build a life in it.
That is why I am supporting Darshini Patel for District 8.
LET’S GET IT DONE.
Read more ↓
“
Darshini is super sharp and very principled. I have seen her get very creative to achieve business objectives and believe she could do the same in this role for SF. Excited to see her impact!
